runtime_summary.object_record_scope: The objects array contains every executable L0-L5 runtime object record. Functional leaves are identified by record_scope=FunctionalLeafObject.

1.description: Major building, site, service, amenity, or relationship system.

3.description: Individually identifiable component within an assembly.

4.description: Geometric feature, connection interface, or policy feature.

5.description: OM5 terminal object retained as the functional leaf identity.

6.description: Detailed part family beneath the functional leaf.

7.description: Assembly of parts that realizes the leaf object.

8.description: Subassembly separating structure, skin, mechanism, or information.

10.description: Replaceable or independently meaningful portion of the element.

11.description: Edge, opening, surface, device, or functional feature.

12.description: Connection, support, seal, control, flow, optical, or spatial interface.

13.description: Material layer, functional region, or metadata layer.

14.description: Material system or information system governing the object.

15.description: Material constituent, signal field, parameter, or evidence field.

16.description: Lowest reusable geometry primitive or logical predicate.

17.description: Joint, seal, contact, boundary, or cardinality detail.

18.description: Operational, structural, environmental, or solver state point.

19.description: Inspection, assurance, provenance, or calibration evidence point.

20.description: Atomic rendered region or atomic semantic assertion.
